input.name: Tinsel & Trivia Quiz Night
input.brief:
**The Anchor Quiz Night**
**Quiz Night with a Gentle Christmas Nod**
**Wednesday, 2 December 2026 | 7:00pm to 9:30pm**

**The Anchor, Horton Road, Stanwell Moor Village, TW19 6AQ**

Join us on **2 December** for a lively night of questions, food, drinks, laughter and friendly competition.

This remains a normal Quiz Night, with a gentle festive nod as December begins. A few seasonal questions and small Christmas touches will appear, but it is not a fully themed Christmas quiz.

This is not a slow, stuffy, sit-in-silence pub quiz. Our quizzes are **fast, funny, lively and properly engaging**, with quick-fire moments, surprises and the kind of atmosphere that gets the whole room involved.

Whether you are a quiz regular, a complete beginner, the one who always knows the random answer, or mainly there for the food, drinks and chaos, you are welcome. You do not need to be a genius. You just need a team, a bit of confidence and a willingness to get stuck in.

**Key information**

Arrive from 6:30pm for a 7pm start.
Quiz starts: **7:00pm sharp**
Ends: around **9:30pm**

Teams: **up to 6 people**
Entry: **£3 per person**
Quiz entry is **cash only**
The bar takes card as usual

**Booking is strongly recommended.** Coming on your own, as a pair or with a smaller group? Let the bar team know and we can help you join another team if you would like to.

**Come early and eat with us**

The pub is open from **12pm**. Our **full dinner menu is available from 4:00pm to 9:00pm**, giving you plenty of time to order food, grab a drink and settle in before the quiz. We recommend ordering before the **7:00pm start** wherever possible.

**What to expect**

A fast-paced, fully hosted pub quiz with accessible rounds covering general knowledge, music, television, film, pictures and random facts.

A mini challenge using **one phone per player** and plenty of friendly rivalry.

**Prizes**

**1st place: £25 bar voucher**, valid on food or drink at The Anchor for one month.

**Second-to-last place: bottle of wine**, because glorious failure deserves rewarding too.

**House rules**

No cheating and no Googling. Phones must be put away during the main quiz unless we tell you otherwise. The quizmaster's decision is final, especially on close calls and tie-breaks. Have a laugh, play fair and get involved.

**Good to know**

Please order food and drinks at the bar. We do not offer table service. We are dog-friendly, so well-behaved pups are welcome too.

**Book your table**

Book online at **the-anchor.pub/book-table** and add **“QUIZ”** in the notes, or call **01753 682707**.

Get your team together and make a proper night of it with food, drinks and one of the liveliest quizzes around.

input.name: Sleigh My Name: Festive Music Bingo
input.brief:
## Music Bingo Night

### Sleigh My Name: A Festive Music Bingo Night

**Get ready for a huge themed Friday night**

On **Friday, 11 December 2026 from 7pm**, Music Bingo returns with Nikki for a heavily themed night packed with massive songs, dressing up, prizes and plenty of chaos.

Christmas number ones, festive singalongs, cheesy crackers and the party anthems that only come out once a year take over both rounds. Expect the songs everyone secretly knows every word to, plus a few surprises to keep the room guessing.

Whether you know every track or simply love a huge singalong, this is one Music Bingo night you will not want to miss.

Nikki will be taking centre stage as host and compere, bringing her usual cheek, energy, crowd interaction and larger-than-life entertainment throughout the night.

## What to expect

**Two fully themed rounds of Music Bingo**

Listen to each song clip, match it to the titles or artists on your card and mark the square. The rounds will explore the theme from different angles, mixing familiar classics with crowd-pleasing surprises.

**Extra points for dressing up**

Teams can earn extra points by getting involved with the theme. A full costume is welcome, but even a small themed touch counts. Christmas jumpers very much encouraged.

**Plenty of Nikki madness**

Expect quick games, cheeky moments, prizes, singing, dancing, crowd participation and a few surprises throughout the night.

## Food and drink

The pub is open from **12pm**. Our **full dinner menu is available from 4pm until 9pm**, giving you plenty of time to arrive early, enjoy food and settle in before Music Bingo begins.

## Price and booking

Entry is **£5 per person, paid in cash on arrival**. The bar takes card as usual.

Music Bingo uses communal seating. Book every person attending so we can prepare enough places and keep groups together where possible.

Book online at **the-anchor.pub** or call **01753 682707**. Walk-ins are welcome if space is available, but booking early is strongly recommended.

## All ages welcome, with parents after 9pm

Bring your friends, family, neighbours or workmates. You do not need expert music knowledge: recognise a few songs, be ready for a laugh and get involved.

**11 December from 7pm to 10pm.**

input.name: Christmas Jackpot Cash Bingo
input.brief:
# The Anchor Cash Bingo Night

**Wednesday, 16 December 2026 | 7:00pm start | finishes around 9:30pm**
**The Anchor, Horton Road, Stanwell Moor Village, TW19 6AQ**

## What it is

A lively, feel-good Cash Bingo Night with 10 games, loads of prizes, a brilliant atmosphere and a proper midweek buzz.

Come for the laughs, stay for the winnings and bring your mates because the fuller the room, the bigger the final jackpot gets.

## Price and how it works

**£10 per bingo book, paid in cash on arrival.**

Buy your book on the night, get comfortable and you are ready to go. Dabbers are available to buy at the pub if you do not have one.

We keep the night moving with quick, clear calling, with the numbers shown on the TVs through the bingo app so everyone can stay in sync. It is friendly and easy to follow, whether you play regularly or have not played for years.

## Prizes

Expect free drink rounds, little treats, £10 food or drink vouchers and bigger prizes as the night builds.

## This event's projected Snowball

**Game 9: Snowball is projected to be £200.**

To win it, you will need a full house within **60 numbers**.

This figure assumes the Snowball remains unclaimed at every earlier Cash Bingo Night. If it is won before this event, the amount and number target must be updated before this event is published.

The Snowball is open to anyone who has attended **any of the last three Cash Bingo Nights**. When it is not won, it rises by **£20** and the number count increases by **2 numbers** for the next event.

## Game 10 Cash Jackpot

Half of all book sales go into the final jackpot. That means **£5 from every book sold** goes straight into the pot, so a bigger crowd creates a bigger final prize.

## Food and drink

The bar is open throughout. The pub is open from **12pm**. Our **full dinner menu is available from 4:00pm to 9:00pm**.

Come early, order food and settle in before the games begin. Short breaks are built into the bingo so you can top up drinks and order food without missing the action.

## Who it is for

Cash Bingo is ideal for groups, friends, families and after-work catch-ups. Families are welcome, and after 9pm under-18s need their parents with them. Players must be **18 or over** to buy a book and play for cash prizes.

## Booking

Book every person attending so we can prepare the communal seating. Bring £10 cash per bingo book on the night.

Book online at **the-anchor.pub** or call **01753 682707**.

input.name: New Year's Eve Party at The Anchor
input.brief:
New Year's Eve Party at The Anchor, Stanwell Moor
Thursday 31 December 2026. Pub open from 4pm. Party with DJ Jermaine from 8pm to 1am.
Free entry with free tickets, 100 places. If there's room on the night, tickets at the bar.

Why we're doing it (owner, 24 November 2026)
Everyone in the village should have somewhere to go on New Year's Eve to spend time with the people they care about. It's a chance for families to come together in the village, celebrate the year, have a good drink, dance along with the DJ, spend time with friends, family and neighbours, and still be able to walk home. Copy should sound really exciting and warm.

What's on
- DJ Jermaine, 8pm to 1am: floor-fillers, guilty pleasures and party classics.
- Song requests through our socials in the run-up.
- Midnight countdown.
- Pub open from 4pm, so people can come early.

Food
The kitchen is closed for the holidays (21 December to 11 January, back on Tuesday 12 January). Takeaway-style food later in the night, nothing fancy. Supplier and serving time not yet confirmed: do not name either until they are.

Good to know
- Children are welcome with a supervising adult. After 9pm, under-18s can stay as long as their parents are with them.
- Stay local, stay safe: walk down, share a lift or book a cab.
- 20 free parking spaces for anyone driving.
- Dogs welcome on a lead.
- Closed on New Year's Day, Friday 1 January 2027.
- No promo texts. A marketing email goes out closer to the time.

Not to say
'Doors open' (say the pub is open from 4pm), fireworks, champagne or anything not listed above.

input.existingShortDescription: See in 2027 with your family, friends and neighbours, right here in the village. DJ Jermaine from 8pm to 1am on Thursday 31 December. Free entry, book your ticket.
input.existingLongDescription:
New Year's Eve is about being with your people. Your family, your friends and your neighbours, all in one room, counting down to midnight together. And when it's over, you can walk home.

That's the whole idea of our New Year's Eve party. Everyone in Stanwell Moor should have somewhere to go on the big night, with no taxi queue and no city centre prices.

DJ Jermaine is on the decks from 8pm until 1am on Thursday 31 December. Expect floor-fillers, guilty pleasures and the songs everyone knows the words to. Got one you need to hear? Send it to us on our socials before the night and we'll try to get it on.

The pub's open from 4pm, so come down early, grab a spot with your lot and settle in before the party gets going. Then it's dancing, a drink or two and a proper countdown to midnight.

Entry is free, but there are only 100 places, so book your free tickets now. If we've still got room on the night, you can get one at the bar.

The kitchen's closed for the holidays, so we'll have takeaway-style food later in the night to keep you dancing.

Children are welcome with a supervising adult. After 9pm, under-18s can stay as long as their parents are with them.

Please leave the car at home if you can. Walk down, share a lift or book a cab, so everyone gets home safely. Here's to 2027, together.

**Friday, 18 September 2026 | 8pm to 10pm**
**The Anchor, Horton Road, Stanwell Moor Village, TW19 6AQ**

Start the weekend the loud way. Join us for a free, family-friendly Karaoke Night with a welcoming crowd, a huge choice of songs and plenty of support for every singer.

Peter will keep the queue moving and the atmosphere encouraging. Confident performers, first-time singers, duets and groups are all welcome. You can come to sing, come to listen or do both; there is no pressure to take the microphone.

Songs are requested through the host on the night, with choices covering different decades and styles. Availability depends on the karaoke library and the time remaining.

Entry is **free**. Karaoke uses communal seating, so book the number of people attending and we will prepare the shared room layout.

Families are welcome. The event runs from **8pm to 10pm** and the bar is open throughout.

Book online at **the-anchor.pub** or call **01753 682707**.

Bring friends, pick your song and kick the weekend off with a night where applause matters more than perfect notes. We will see you on **Friday 18 September**.
